classification.difficultyReason: Direct recognition or a familiar short procedure. Page 44 establishes that the upper endpoint 4 is included.

content.prompt:
Let $A$ be a subset of $\mathbb R$. Define the following.
$$\begin{aligned}\max A&=x\in A\text{ where }x\ge a\text{ for any }a\in A\\\min A&=x\in A\text{ where }x\le a\text{ for any }a\in A\end{aligned}$$
Find $\max[-1,4]$.

answer.worked: The closed interval includes $4$, and every member is at most $4$. Thus $\max[-1,4]=4$.
